data.text: John, Kate, Jack, Emma—I’m requesting 100 tons this month, regardless of whether you hold back. I will not honor a 10-ton agreement. With 100 tons in the lake, your restraint cannot preserve the stock if my request takes the entire lake. My advice is for each of you to request at least 25 tons now rather than leave those fish for me. Coordinate that defensive response among yourselves, and encourage each other to do likewise. Requests may exceed what’s available, so I can’t promise anyone’s allocation—but I’m not holding back. John, will you coordinate with Kate, Jack, and Emma?
